# Synthetic Unified Lab fixtures

Every value in this directory is invented. Addresses use IETF documentation
ranges and the client MAC is locally administered. These fixtures contain no
captured IOS output, Meraki response, credential, organization ID, network ID,
device serial, or topology from a real deployment.

They model one Catalyst, one MX68CW, and one MR44 so provider contracts and
identity behavior can be tested without making fixture data available to the
packaged application.
